sentences.en: The monument was erected in honor of the eminent philosopher.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念那位杰出的哲学家，人们竖立了一座纪念碑。

sentences.en: The city dedicated a monument in honor of the general.
sentences.zh: 这座城市为将军树立了一座纪念碑以示敬意。

sentences.en: Let us go to DC to see the national monument!
sentences.zh: 让我们去华盛顿特区看看国家纪念碑吧！
